{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) is a tight-tolerance fit feature, but the drawing specifies a plating/coating (I.Z.B.P.) with no allowance or note indicating that the tolerance accounts for coating thickness. The plating will reduce the bore diameter and can cause the intended fit to fail; the designer must either increase the pre-plate hole size by the expected coating thickness or add a note specifying masking of the bore."

,"recommended_correction":"Add a note stating the H7 tolerance applies after plating, or adjust the pre-plate dimension to allow for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness, or specify that the ⌀16 H7 bore is to be masked during plating."}]}
